name: Žandari
description: Žandari (Pishpirik) is a Serbian/Balkan fishing card game. 2-4 players. 52-card deck. 4 face-up table + hand cards. Capture by matching rank or summing to played card value. Jack clears entire table. Score: most cards=2pts, most clubs=1pt, 2♣=1pt, 10♦=1pt. First to 11.

history.origins: Žandari is a fishing game played in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The name Žandari is also used for the Jack, which can capture all the cards from the table. The name is thought to derive from the French or Italian word gendarme (policeman). This page is based on information from Veselko Kelava.
timeline: 20th century: documented as fishing game in Bosnia and Herzegovina (source: Veselko Kelava).
history.cultural: Popular in Serbia and surrounding regions.

setup.deck: 52 cards. A=1, 2-10=face. K/Q have no capture value.
setup.dealing: 4 face-up center. Hand cards dealt. Jacks in initial 4 go to cutter.

rules.objective: Score points by capturing cards and bonuses (most cards 2 pts, most clubs 1 pt, 2♣ 1 pt, 10♦ 1 pt). The match is played until a player or team reaches the agreed target score (typically 11, 21 or other).
rules.gameplay: Play 1 card. Capture by rank match (single) or sum (multiple). Jack captures ALL table cards. Must capture if possible. Last capturer gets remaining cards.

strategy.basic: Save Jacks for big table captures.

scoring.description: Most cards=2pts. Most clubs=1pt. 2♣=1pt. 10♦=1pt. First to 11.
